description_en: Invokes this operation to perform a paging query on the group list
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-group-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --super-group-id 8vDubXr4nUvZkNgk9mle010200 --group-name GroupName1 --current-page 1 --group-types example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceGroupList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。最大值是200。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent group. Specify this parameter to query the subgroups of a parent group
parameters.help_zh: 父组ID。查询某父组下的子分组列表时，需传入此参数
parameters.name: super_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The group name.

If you specify a group name, the system queries groups by name. Fuzzy match is not supported for group names.
If you do not specify this parameter, all groups are queried
parameters.help_zh:
分组名称。

传入分组名称，则根据名称进行查询。不支持分组名称模糊查询。
若不传入此参数，则进行全量分组查询
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The type of groups to query.

Currently, only one value is supported: LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC, which indicates dynamic groups. If you do not specify this parameter, static groups are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的分组类型。

目前仅支持传入一个，且为LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC，表示动态分组。不传入时，默认为静态分组
parameters.name: group_types

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
